name: the-labyrinth
title: The Labyrinth
description: Descend through endless labyrinth levels rendered as SVG — collect keys and gems, dodge ghosts, and warp through portals.
author: luarmr

commands.name: maze
commands.title: Play the Labyrinth
commands.subtitle: Maze Game
commands.description: Escape level after level of randomly generated mazes: unlock doors with keys, collect gems, dodge the ghost, and survive the fog.

commands.name: custom
commands.title: Custom Labyrinth
commands.subtitle: Sandbox
commands.description: Play a labyrinth with a chosen level size and any mix of modifiers. Disabled until you enable it in extension settings.

preferences.name: level
preferences.title: Level
preferences.description: Maze size and intensity (1–99). Width and height cap at 26×15.

preferences.name: key
preferences.title: Modifiers
preferences.label: Key — locked exit
preferences.description: Place a key and keep the exit locked until you find it.

preferences.name: portals
preferences.label: Portals
preferences.description: Two portals warp you across the maze.

preferences.name: fog
preferences.label: Fog
preferences.description: Darkness hides the maze until you find the candle.

preferences.name: ice
preferences.label: Ice
preferences.description: Icy floors — you slide until you hit a wall.

preferences.name: shifting
preferences.label: Shifting walls
preferences.description: Walls open and close every few moves.

preferences.name: footprints
preferences.title: Footprints
preferences.description: How long the trail of visited cells stays visible.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
